meta.name: The March of Bellweather
meta.tone: warm, strange and commercially alive above; ancient and unsettling below

factions.name: The Brass Ledger
factions.description: Creditors, auctioneers and route monopolists who insist trade requires order.

factions.name: The Roadwardens
factions.description: Guides, carriers and surveyors who want the old roads reopened safely.

factions.name: The Wild Choir
factions.description: Keepers of creatures and places that do not accept ownership easily.

commodities.name: Glowfruit
commodities.description: A common luminous fruit used as food, bait and cheap creature feed.

commodities.name: Moonmoss
commodities.description: Medicinal moss that becomes valuable during illness and travel disruption.

commodities.name: Whisper Ink
commodities.description: Ink used by archives, surveyors and people who alter records.

commodities.name: Bellglass
commodities.description: Resonant glass used in wards, instruments and old-road apparatus.

commodities.name: Stormsalt
commodities.description: Volatile crystals used in elemental training and illegal racing tonics.

commodities.name: Star-Iron
commodities.description: Rare metal recovered from ruins whose joins do not resemble smithing.

commodities.name: River Pearl
commodities.description: A living pearl harvested from long-finned river mussels.

commodities.name: Blackroot
commodities.description: A durable root traded as food, dye stock and mine ration.

locations.name: Bellweather
locations.description: A debt-built market town of auction halls, leaning roofs and polite threats.

locations.name: Brambleward
locations.description: A wet woodland settlement where paths move and creatures are treated as neighbours.

locations.name: Cinderdeep
locations.description: A mining town built around furnaces and a sealed shaft older than its maps.

properties.name: The Leaning House
properties.description: Your damaged, indebted home and future estate. Something hums beneath its cellar.

properties.name: Riverside Rooms
properties.description: Three damp rooms whose tenants care more about location than plaster.

properties.name: Bramble Woodlot
properties.description: A managed woodlot with disputed paths and future creature-habitat potential.

properties.name: Cinderdeep Storefront
properties.description: A soot-dark shop positioned between the mine lifts and the workers' quarter.

creature_species.name: Ashcat
creature_species.description: A six-eared feline whose fur warms when danger approaches.

creature_species.name: Mossback
creature_species.description: A broad, antlered creature valued for stamina, hauling and steady temperament.

creature_species.name: Scrywing
creature_species.description: A feathered serpent prized for focus, route-sense and nervous speed.

creature_species.name: Riverstrider
creature_species.description: A long-legged amphibious racer dominant on wet courses.

creature_species.name: Brassbeak
creature_species.description: A clever scavenging bird used by traders and dishonest bookmakers.

creature_species.name: Gloomhound
creature_species.description: A powerful, reserved animal whose shadow is never correctly aligned.

magic_modules.name: Ember Node
magic_modules.description: Projects heat through a compatible socket.

magic_modules.name: Mend Node
magic_modules.description: Reorders living tissue at a manageable cost.

magic_modules.name: Frost Node
magic_modules.description: Draws heat away from a target.

magic_modules.name: Siphon Link
magic_modules.description: Linked damage restores a portion of the user's vitality.

magic_modules.name: Spread Link
magic_modules.description: Linked effects can reach multiple targets once group combat exists.

enemies.name: Road Cutpurse
enemies.description: A desperate robber who knows where traders keep their quick-access coin.

enemies.name: Marsh Prowler
enemies.description: A territorial animal with plated shoulders and no interest in your debt.

enemies.name: Ledger Collector
enemies.description: An armed creditor whose paperwork is more dangerous than the club.

enemies.name: Shaft Echo
enemies.description: Something from the sealed mine repeating the outline of a person.

events.title: The Broken Courier
events.text: A courier crouches beneath a cracked milestone beside a sealed black crate.

choices.text: Spend 20 crowns treating the courier and ask what happened.
choices.outcome: The courier shows you a route mark that does not appear on any current map.

choices.text: Take the crate and promise to deliver it without questions.
choices.outcome: The courier pays immediately. Something inside the crate scratches once.

choices.text: Leave before the problem becomes yours.
choices.outcome: You keep moving. By dusk, someone else has removed every trace of the scene.

events.title: Lights Under Water
events.text: Cold lights move beneath the river in a pattern your companion seems to recognise.

choices.text: Follow the lights along the bank.
choices.outcome: The lights lead to a stone arch beneath the surface, its sockets still faintly warm.

choices.text: Use the disturbance to gather whatever rises from the riverbed.
choices.outcome: You recover two living pearls before the lights vanish downstream.

choices.text: Do not let curiosity cost another day.
choices.outcome: You reach the next toll before nightfall and save a little road money.

events.title: The Roof Petition
events.text: Tenants from the riverside quarter ask property owners to fund storm repairs.

choices.outcome: The work begins immediately, and local rents become a little less precarious.

choices.text: Offer the money as a high-interest private loan.
choices.outcome: They accept because the storm will not negotiate. Your name spreads for other reasons.

events.title: A Quiet Auction Tip
events.text: A bookmaker claims a repossessed Cinderdeep storefront will be listed below value.

choices.text: Pay 40 crowns for the full valuation notes.
choices.outcome: The notes reveal real structural damage, but also a planned mine-gate expansion.

choices.text: Ignore the property and ask for tonight's race favourite.
choices.outcome: The tip wins narrowly. You make a small profit and acquire a taste for the noise.
The bookmaker shrugs. Information belongs to whoever pays before it becomes obvious.

events.title: The Unlicensed Breeder
events.text: A breeder offers a rare egg without pedigree papers while your companion watches closely.

choices.text: Report the sale to the Wild Choir.
choices.outcome: The Choir takes the egg into care and gives you access to its lineage archive.

choices.text: Pay a 150-crown deposit and reserve the egg.
choices.outcome: The breeder hides the egg off-site. Breeding is not implemented yet, but the promise persists.

choices.text: Question the breeder about the missing papers.
choices.outcome: Under pressure, the breeder uses an extinct name: wayling.
